Name: Day Limiter
Author: Parzivl
Description:
[b]Update 1.0.5[/b]
[list]
[*]So after playing with my own mod, I found it way too easy to just change the settings at the end of the last day to play "one more day" so I added an option to "lock in" the mod settings after they are saved to prevent this.
[*]Added a break timer that will enforce a break time from the game for a specified number of minutes. This will lock you out of playing the game unless you delete the "TakeBreakUntilTime" timestamp from the config.json so please use with caution!
[*]Removed optional dependency on GMCM Options mod because it wasn't necessary to do what I needed it to do.
[/list]
[size=5]Description[/size]

This mod is for those of us who can't be trusted not to play "one more day" until it's 4 am on a work/school night.

It allows players to set a day limit on how long they want to play Stardew Valley. Once the day limit is reached, the game will warn you that this is the last day when you wake up that morning, then after going to bed and saving the next morning, the game will automatically quit. Optionally, you can lock in the mod settings until the game quits by selecting "Prevent Changing After Save".

(New!) Break Mode Option - You can set a break mode to force you to wait a defined number of minutes until the game can be played after saving and quitting. This can only be configured from within the config menu while in-game. This will lock you out of playing the game unless you delete the "TakeBreakUntilTime" timestamp from the config.json so please use with caution!

[b]Note: Although not required for the mod to function, I HIGHLY recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] so this mod can be turned on and configured while in-game.[/b]


[size=5]Configuration[/size]

Enabling the mod and changing the settings can be done through[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b] [/b](recommended) or by editing the config.json file that is created when first running the game .

The mod will begin as disabled by default. Changing the config.json to enable the mod will cause it to be enabled every time you play the game. Enabling the mod through GMCM will only enable the mod for that play session, because changing the "enable" property through GMCM will not change the config.json, however changing any other settings will update that property in the config file.


[size=5]Technical[/size]

Implements the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional but highly recommended) interface to change settings in-game.

Source code: [url=https://github.com/tadfoster/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/tadfoster/StardewValleyMods[/url].
